text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross! Tamamo Cross wins it! 
Proving her pride as the upperclassman, 
she has triumphed over Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following the Takarazuka Kinen, she 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as well!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: W-W-WOOOOOAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We did it...! We really freakin' did it, 
TRAINER!!!!!!!
choice_data_list: That was an incredible run, Tamamo!
That was an incredible run, Tamamo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'm Number 1! I went out there 
to take the win, and I took it all the 
wayyyy! WOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooooo!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross, who had always run for her 
family's sake. Today, she burns with a 
flame that blazes even hotter—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a pure athlete, she burned down to pure 
white ash. It was truly a victory born of 
total concentration.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Daddy~! Tama-neechan is! She's...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Winning or losing, it doesn't 
matter anymore... As long as they thrill 
the fans and run safely to the end.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tama, our whole family is... 
Just thinkin' about it fills my heart to 
burstin'...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Tama-neene is so amazing! I wanna be able 
to run like that someday too~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama... Congratulations. Though I was 
defeated, today, I...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that was the first time I ever 
ran all out. All because I got to race 
Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—You too? I feel like this was the first 
time I gave it every single thing I had.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The bento before the race today was crazy 
good. Wonder if that helped too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still—ya know, don'tcha? Today was just 
the debut. This ain't where it ends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Arima Kinen. The real 
showdown. That's where our...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know. But for me... that alone is still 
not enough.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with you more and more, 
Tama. So I'll be waiting for you at the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh—?! Three GⅠ races in a row? Oguri, 
you're still only in the Classic Class...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, no need to worry. I am—Oguri 
Cap."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Distance, track conditions, rotation—none 
of it matters. As long as I have a dream, 
I can run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. So, what's next? The Japan Cup, 
or maybe...
choice_data_list: Let's make the Arima Kinen our goal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see. The Japan Cup is...
choice_data_list:
We'll decide on that by seeing how things 
go.

We should judge that based on how things 
turn out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was strong today. If only she 
can keep this up, but the problem is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can... still get stronger. 
Thanks to Oguri, I know I've still got 
more in me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm still partway there, but I won today. 
By the Arima Kinen, it oughta be complete.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I'm the strongest, I won't lose 
to anyone! No one should be able to beat 
me. They shouldn't!!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Even so... if it can be overcome—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That might be... the finished version of 
him.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She really is that incredible of an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tamamo Cross was strong in victory, and 
Oguri Cap was strong in defeat. The dream 
rivalry continues into the Arima Kinen."
